No source-backed absolute Rth or all-loaded derating curve;0.8blanketfactor remains assumption.; Mating-cycle endurance and crimp resistance are unestablished;do not use Molex values.; Cable pin1 can be any application net;keying does not standardize battery polarity.; Initial/conditioned resistance ceilings do not establish the spec6/12mohm typical proxies.
blocker_resolution: (1) Binding: exact header B2B-PH-K-S and housing PHR-2 are in the archived JST PH sheet tables, and the 'No. 1 circuit' marks on both drawings give the positional map; recipe below. (2) Rth/0.8 derating: the recipe drops the thermal model entirely (op-only, DC resistance), so no assumed thermal value enters the binding; the rating checks use only JST's sourced current-at-AWG and contact-temperature limit, which JST defines as including temperature rise. (4) Pin-1 polarity: roles are positional pass-throughs P_k->W_k with no polarity semantics. (5) Typical proxies: Rmate is bound to the sourced initial maximum 10 mohm and labelled an upper bound. All five critical facts are already MFR_DATASHEET/H fields of the entry, sourced from the archived JST PDF (https://www.jst-mfg.com/product/pdf/eng/ePH.pdf, sha in ledger). The entry record already lists no simulation_blockers; only STATE.model_blockers carries this text.

Package terminal '1'..'2' = PCB tail of circuit k (P_k); 'W1'..'W2' = wire of housing circuit k (W_k).

runtime_check.new_probe_needed_for_class: Add a BEH-CON-WTB branch to dc_probe_definition: roles {P1:'anode', every other role:'return'}, excitations=[DCExcitation(positive_net='return', negative_net='anode', value=i_rated A)], comparison observable 'dc_resistance'-style (reuse the BEH-MAG-INDUCTOR observable but keyed on node 'anode', i.e. V(anode)/current); add BEH-CON-WTB to the dc_probe_receipt_errors class set in runtime_receipt_errors. Verify the locked B2 deck hash via _locked_probe_deck before borrowing its 0.1% tolerance.

limitations: One lumped resistance per position equal to Phoenix's stated durability-test contact resistance (1.4 mohm); not labelled a maximum, and Phoenix does not say whether it includes the screw clamp.
No thermal or derating model. Current capacity vs ambient follows the p11 MSTB/MSTBA 2-pos curve (12 A to about 84 C, read by eye); the recipe does not encode it.
Voltage depends on category: III/2 320 V pair; III/3 limited by plug 250 V; II/2 630 V per current Phoenix sheets.
Live mating/unmating prohibited (no switching power, IEC 61984).
Position numbering is library convention; positions are electrically identical, P_k and W_k are colocated.
Wire resistance and ampacity are separate.

pin_map_evidence: 1757242 PDF p1/p2: 'Number of positions 2', 'Number of potentials 2', 'Pin layout Linear pinning', 'Solder pins per potential 1'; 1757019 page: 'number of positions: 2, number of connections: 2', mates MSTBA. Each header solder pin k is the same potential as plug position k (colocated pin/socket). Phoenix prints no position numbers, so '1','2' (solder pins) and 'W1','W2' (plug clamps) are library numbering applied consistently to both halves.
